capabilities: Generate bookmarklets that capture web highlights as Markdown
Send clips to daily or weekly periodic notes, any Markdown note, or a canvas
Build a Chrome-based browser extension wrapper around a bookmarklet via an external service
Convert highlighted HTML to Markdown with Turndown, including tables
disambiguation: Not a standalone browser extension; it is an Obsidian plugin that generates bookmarklets (and optionally extension wrappers) for capturing highlights.
extras: The plugin calls an author-maintained external service to build the Chrome extension wrapper; the extension must be loaded manually via developer mode, and detailed docs live on a separate site.
motivation: The author got the idea from modifying a Gist posted in an Obsidian forum thread and used other plugin repos as examples for building it.
problem: There is no built-in way to grab highlighted text from a browser and write it into a chosen Obsidian note, periodic note, or canvas.

relations.evidence: Weekly clippers need the Periodic Notes plugin with weekly notes turned on
I used the following Obsidian Plugin repos as examples of accomplishing my goal
Turndown is used in the bookmarklet code to parse highlighted HTML and convert it to Markdown

requires.name: Daily notes, Periodic Notes, Calendar, or Canvas (depending on clipper type)

summary: Configurable bookmarklet and Chrome extension generator that captures web highlights as Markdown entries into Obsidian notes or canvases.
